content: Figure FIGREF2 illustrates the proposed multimodal NER (MNER) model. First, we obtain word embeddings, character embeddings, and visual features (Section SECREF3 ). A Bi-LSTM-CRF model then takes as input a sequence of tokens, each of which comprises a word token, a character sequence, and an image, in their respective representation (Section SECREF4 ). At each decoding step, representations from each modality are combined via the modality attention module to produce an entity label for each token ( SECREF5 ). We formulate each component of the model in the following subsections.
